thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD-INC-48721: HIGH - inference-queue backlog > 10k for 5m. auto-pager: page fired to @eng-oncall and escalation policy 'inference-hotpaths'.

alice chen: acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it. grabbing logs + checking autoscaler status. :eyes:

bob rao: on standby, will help with manual scale if needed. any customer impact yet?

alice chen: seeing steady 10-12k queued requests, processing rate ~350 req/s, incoming ~750 req/s. CPU on worker nodes at 95% on some pools. Latency p99 for gen is 9s and growing. I think autoscaler isn't reacting quickly (scale-up lag).

charlie: noted. autoscaler metrics show provision_delay_seconds spiking. suspicion: node quota exhausted in us-west1 region. Can someone check GCP quota and preemptible spot pool?

alice chen: running `kubectl get hpa -n inference` -> HPA shows target 80%, current 95%, desired replicas 120, available nodes 100. `kubectl describe hpa` shows failed scale due to node provisioning timeout.

alice chen: log snippet:
```
[2024-09-21T14:02:17Z] scale-controller: desired_replicas=120 -> provision_request_sent
[2024-09-21T14:02:40Z] cloud-provider: quota_check failed: CPU_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
[2024-09-21T14:02:40Z] scale-controller: scale-failed -> backoff=30s
```

eng-sre-bot: automated recommendation: attempt manual node spin-up and temporary burst to Dedicated reserved pool. See playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-qos

bob rao: trying manual scale now: `kubectl scale deploy inference-worker --replicas=140 -n inference` -> patch accepted but pods stuck Pending (0/40 nodes available).

alice chen: confirming GCP quota: Compute CPUs in us-west1 at limit. open ticket to cloud-ops, requesting emergency quota bump.

charlie: while quota is being requested, let's open a short-term mitigation: 1) reroute low-priority traffic to cheaper, cached model variant (gpt-lite) 2) enable prefix KV cache hit bypass to reduce DB ops 3) enable degraded-mode for background batch jobs.

alice chen: implemented route change: updated routing policy to send model=default to model=gpt-lite for route /v1/generate with header `x-load-shed: true`. Pushed canary to 10% -> monitoring.

pagerduty: Reminder: if not acknowledged by next escalation window, will page escalation target: eng-leads.

bob rao: also kicked off manual GCE instance creation (non-preemptible) to bypass provisioning delay: `gcloud compute instances create inference-burst-01 --zone=us-west1-b --machine-type=n1-highcpu-32 --image=redwood-inference-node-v2` -> request submitted.

alice chen: good. started provisioning - nodes are joining cluster. observed pods moving from Pending -> ContainerCreating -> Running, processing rate improved to ~520 req/s. queue shrinking slowly.

charlie: customer impact check: support dashboard shows ~120 customer requests failing with 503s in last 10 minutes. Most are low-volume integrations. Opening support incidence banner and status page draft.

alice chen: filed incident on status.redwood.ai: "Investigating: Inference queue backlog causing elevated error/latency". ETA for initial mitigation: 12 minutes.

bob rao: once new nodes are up, we should scale down gracefully to avoid overprovisioning. propose HPA conservative cooldown tweak: reduce stabilization window from 5m -> 1m for this hotpath and allow transient aggressive scale-ups for next 30 minutes. Thoughts?

charlie: okay to adjust temporarily. make sure rollback plan in 30m. Also create alert to revert cooldown settings.

alice chen: applied HPA tweak via `kubectl patch hpa inference-hotpath -n inference -p '{"spec": {"behavior": {"scaleUp": {"stabilizationWindowSeconds": 60}}}}'` -> applied. Monitoring.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-INC-48721 acknowledged by alice chen at 14:03:55 UTC. Escalation timer paused.

alice chen: update: new nodes fully joined, processing rate 780 req/s, queue down to 3.2k. p50 latency back to 120ms, p99 2.1s. No new 5xx spike since manual nodes online.

bob rao: great. initiating graceful scale down plan: set max replicas to 160 for 20m then revert to 110.

charlie: support banner live: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-48721 (draft) - message: "We are investigating elevated request latency and errors for inference endpoints; mitigation in progress."

alice chen: postmortem checklist: track autoscaler metrics, identify whether quota event can be predicted, consider warm pool or capacity reservation for peak windows. Also add a runbook step to auto-fallthrough to gpt-lite after queue exceeds 8k for >3m.

bob rao: also recommend we enable proactive quota alerts with cloud-ops to avoid surprises. I'll open a ticket.

eng-sre-bot: action items captured: [A1] cloud-ops: quota bump confirmation & postmortem (bob rao) [A2] infra: add warm pool / reserved capacity proposal (charlie) [A3] product: customer impact comms + post-incident note (alice chen) [A4] eng-runtime: improve autoscaler backoff behavior (eng-team).

alice chen: tying up here. will handoff to oncall rotation for watch and follow-up. leaving notes in incident doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:

charlie: thx. handoff acknowledged.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-48721 -> status: Mitigated. Closed automated pager at 14:20:50 UTC.

alice chen: final: queue fully drained at 14:19:12 UTC. closing thread and creating postmortem stub.

bob rao: copy, will add timeline and logs.

charlie: adding root-cause hypothesis: autoscaler unable to request additional quota -> scale-controller backoff. mitigation: capacity reservations and smarter queuing/fallthrough.

incident-bot: Reminders: assign postmortem owner within 24h, severity: Sev2, link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-qos.
